goal: Turn the round page into a restrained, highly scannable tournament ranking sheet whose identity comes from composition, ruled hierarchy, rank numerics, and semantic status rather than a decorative hero.
preserve: all routes, stores, requests, and business handlers

requiredDirection.canvas: warm paper canvas with one contained navy tournament masthead
requiredDirection.hierarchy: event/round context -> ranking summary -> ruled ranking rows -> deck/player detail and status
requiredDirection.geometry: low-radius rectangular islands and ruled rows; no pill clouds or floating decorative panels
requiredDirection.color: navy for tournament identity, yellow used sparsely for first-place or current selection, red only for meaningful competitive/status accents
requiredDirection.type: restrained CJK hierarchy with strong tabular rank numerics and readable secondary metadata
requiredDirection.responsive: preserve row scan order at 390 and 536; use additional desktop width for legibility, not premature dense columns

mustNot: add a decorative hero or unrelated database-driven artwork
change ranking order, scores, deck/player data, or navigation behavior
acceptance: 390, 536, and 1280 show event context, round identity, ranking hierarchy, and the first meaningful rows without accidental dead space
rank, player, deck, score, and status remain legible with zero internal clipping
empty slots and gold/current/status branches remain distinguishable in text as well as color
all real controls pass pointer, Enter, Space, visible focus, 44px ownership where applicable, and reduced-motion checks
zero horizontal page overflow, zero external writes, zero cross-route regression
